:root{ --bg:#f0f4f8;--white:#ffffff;--ink:#0f172a;--ink2:#334155;--ink3:#64748b; --line:#e2e8f0;--line2:#cbd5e1; --blue:#1e40af;--blue-m:#2563eb;--blue-l:#dbeafe;--blue-xl:#eff6ff; --green:#166534;--green-m:#16a34a;--green-l:#dcfce7; --red:#b91c1c;--red-l:#fee2e2; --orange:#c2410c;--orange-l:#ffedd5; --purple:#6d28d9;--purple-l:#ede9fe; --yellow:#92400e;--yellow-l:#fef3c7; --font:'DM Sans',sans-serif;--mono:'DM Mono',monospace; --r:4px;--r2:8px; --sh:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.08),0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.04); --sh2:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.10),0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.06); } *,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0} html{font-size:13px} body{font-family:var(--font);background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column} /* ── HEADER ── */ header{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:0 16px;height:58px;box-shadow:var(--sh2);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:300;flex-shrink:0} .h-logo{font-size:.92rem;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px} .h-logo em{opacity:.55;font-style:normal;font-weight:400} .h-sep{width:1px;height:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2)} .h-sub{font-size:.72rem;opacity:.75} .h-gap{flex:1} .h-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px} .h-nav button{background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);color:#fff;border-radius:var(--r);padding:3px 9px;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--font);font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;transition:background .12s} .h-nav button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.28)} .h-nav .mes-lbl{font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;min-width:100px;text-align:center} .h-save{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);color:#fff;border-radius:var(--r);padding:4px 11px;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--font);font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;transition:all .12s} .h-save:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.3)} .h-torn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px} .h-torn-lbl{font-size:.7rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);font-weight:500} .h-torn-sel{background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);color:#fff;border-radius:var(--r);padding:4px 8px;font-family:var(--font);font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;outline:none;transition:all .12s} .h-torn-sel:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.32)} .h-torn-sel option{color:var(--ink);background:#fff;font-weight:600} .empty-torn{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:60px 24px;text-align:center;gap:14px;color:var(--ink3)} .empty-torn .et-icon{font-size:3rem;opacity:.6} .empty-torn h2{font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)} .empty-torn p{font-size:.82rem;max-width:420px;line-height:1.5} .empty-torn .et-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center} /* ── TABS ── */ .tabs{background:var(--white);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 16px;gap:1px;flex-shrink:0;overflow-x:auto} .tab{padding:9px 14px;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink3);cursor:pointer;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;white-space:nowrap;transition:all .13s;user-select:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px} .tab:hover{color:var(--blue-m)} .tab.active{color:var(--blue-m);border-bottom-color:var(--blue-m);font-weight:700} .tab-icon{font-size:.85rem} /* ── TOOLBAR ── */ .toolbar{background:var(--white);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 16px;flex-wrap:wrap;flex-shrink:0} .tb-sep{width:1px;height:20px;background:var(--line2)} .lbl{font-size:.68rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink3);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em} .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:var(--r);font-family:var(--font);font-size:.74rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid transparent;transition:all .12s;white-space:nowrap} .btn-p{background:var(--blue-m);color:#fff}.btn-p:hover{background:var(--blue)} .btn-o{background:var(--white);color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--line2)}.btn-o:hover{background:var(--bg)} .btn-g{background:var(--green-m);color:#fff}.btn-g:hover{background:var(--green)} .btn-r{background:var(--red);color:#fff}.btn-r:hover{opacity:.9} .btn-sm{padding:3px 8px;font-size:.7rem} sel,select.sel{height:26px;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);padding:0 8px;font-family:var(--font);font-size:.74rem;color:var(--ink);background:var(--white);cursor:pointer;outline:none} select.sel:focus{border-color:var(--blue-m)} input.inp{height:26px;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);padding:0 8px;font-family:var(--font);font-size:.74rem;outline:none} input.inp:focus{border-color:var(--blue-m)} .llegenda{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center} .leg{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;cursor:default} .leg-b{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:2px;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.1);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:.55rem;font-weight:700;flex-shrink:0} .leg span{font-size:.65rem;color:var(--ink3)} /* ── LAYOUT ── */ .layout{display:flex;flex:1;overflow:hidden} /* ── SIDEBAR ── */ .sidebar{width:196px;background:var(--white);border-right:1px solid var(--line);flex-shrink:0;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;scrollbar-width:thin;transition:width .18s} .sidebar.collapsed{width:0;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;border:none} .sb-toggle{position:fixed;left:196px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:300;background:#3b82f6;color:#fff;border:none;cursor:pointer;width:13px;height:44px;border-radius:0 5px 5px 0;font-size:.6rem;padding:0;line-height:1;transition:left .18s} .sb-sec{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:7px 0} .sb-hdr{padding:3px 11px 5px;font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink3)} .sb-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:4px 11px;font-size:.74rem;cursor:pointer;border-left:2px solid transparent;transition:all .1s;user-select:none} .sb-item:hover{background:var(--bg)} .sb-item.active{background:var(--blue-xl);border-left-color:var(--blue-m);color:var(--blue-m);font-weight:600} .sb-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0} .sb-count{margin-left:auto;font-size:.62rem;font-family:var(--mono);background:var(--bg);padding:1px 5px;border-radius:9px;color:var(--ink3)} /* ── CONTENT ── */ .content{flex:1;overflow:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px;padding:12px} /* ── KPI row ── */ .kpi-row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap} .kpi{flex:1;min-width:95px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:9px 12px;border-top:3px solid} .kpi-l{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--ink3);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:4px} .kpi-v{font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:700;font-family:var(--mono);line-height:1;color:var(--ink)} .kpi-s{font-size:.62rem;color:var(--ink3);font-family:var(--mono);margin-top:3px} .kpi.bl{border-top-color:#2563eb}.kpi.gn{border-top-color:#16a34a} .kpi.rd{border-top-color:#dc2626}.kpi.or{border-top-color:#d97706} .kpi.lv{border-top-color:#7c3aed}.kpi.cy{border-top-color:#0891b2} /* ── CARD ── */ .card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);box-shadow:var(--sh);overflow:hidden} .card-hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:8px table.q{border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.68rem;min-width:max-content} table.q th,table.q td{border:1px solid #d1d5db;text-align:center;padding:0;height:21px;white-space:nowrap} table.q thead{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10} table.q thead tr:nth-child(1) th{background:#0f172a;color:#fff;height:24px;font-size:.72rem} table.q thead tr:nth-child(2) th{background:#fff;color:#64748b;height:16px;font-size:.6rem} table.q thead tr:nth-child(3) th.we{background:#fff;color:#dc2626} table.q thead th.ci{background:#f0fdf4;color:#000;text-align:center} table.q thead th.ci.ci-title{background:#dbeafe !important;border-bottom:none !important} table.q thead th.ci.ci-lbl{background:#bfdbfe !important;text-align:left !important} table.q thead th.cr{background:#f0fdf4 !important;color:#000 !important} table.q td.c-ups{padding:0 5px;text-align:left;font-size:.66rem;color:var(--ink2);max-width:120px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis} td.c-cont{font-size:.58rem;color:var(--ink3);font-style:italic;min-width:80px} table.q td.c-res{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.68rem;font-weight:700;padding:0 3px} table.q tr.even td.c-ups,table.q tr.even td.c-nom,table.q tr.even td.c-cont{background:#f8fafc} table.q tr.tr-tot td{background:#1e40af !important;color:#fff !important;font-weight:700;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem} table.q tr.tr-tot td.lbl{text-align:left;padding-left:6px;font-size:.66rem} .tc{width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;font-size:.66rem;font-family:var(--mono);position:relative} .tc:hover{filter:brightness(1.1)} .tc select{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;cursor:pointer;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:.68rem} /* ── PLANTILLA TABLE ── */ table.pt{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:.75rem} table.pt th{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;padding:7px 10px;text-align:left;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:600;position:sticky;top:0} table.pt td{padding:5px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)} table.pt tbody tr:hover{background:var(--blue-xl)} table.pt tbody tr:hover td.c-nom-pt{color:var(--blue-m)} .badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:9999px;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:700} .b-ok{background:var(--green-l);color:var(--green)} .b-int{background:var(--blue-xl);color:var(--blue-m)} .b-int28{background:#f3e8ff;color:#6d28d9} .b-int21{background:#fce7f3;color:#9d174d} .b-in{background:var(--red-l);color:var(--red)} .b-prog{background:var(--purple-l);color:var(--purple)} .b-prog28{background:#d1fae5;color:#065f46} .b-sub{background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e} /* ── ROTACIÓ EDITOR ── */ .rot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(430px,1fr));gap:14px} .rot-card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid .rot-badge{width:52px;height:26px;border-radius:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;flex-shrink:0} .rot-title{font-weight:700;font-size:.82rem} .rot-sub{font-size:.68rem;color:var(--ink3)} .rot-days{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:3px} .rot-day{border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:3px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:1px;padding:3px 1px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .1s;min-height:38px;justify-content:center} .rot-day:hover{border-color:var(--blue-m)} .rot-day.active{border-color:var(--blue-m);background:var(--blue-xl)} .rot-day-name{font-size:.58rem;color:var(--ink3);font-weight:600} .rot-day-val{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;font-family:var(--mono)} .rot-day select{width:100%;border:none;background:transparent;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;outline:none;color:inherit} .rot-stats{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap} .rot-stat{font-size:.68rem;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:9px} /* calendari mensual complet */ .rot-cal-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:2px} .rot-cal-hdr{text-align:center;font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink3);padding:3px 1px;border-bottom:2px solid .rot-cal-cell.day-work{background:#eff6ff;border-color:#bfdbfe} .rot-cal-cell.day-we-work{background:#faf5ff;border-color:#ddd6fe} .rot-cal-cell.day-fs{background:#f3f4f6;border-color:#d1d5db} .rot-cal-num{font-size:.58rem;color:var(--ink3);font-weight:600;width:100%;line-height:1.2;padding-left:2px} .rot-cal-cod{font-size:.65rem;font-weight:700;font-family:var(--mono);padding:1px .rot-cal-h.h-zero{color:#cbd5e1} .rot-cal-cell:not(.empty){cursor:pointer} .rot-cal-cell:not(.empty):hover{filter:brightness(.97);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--blue-m) inset} .rot-cal-sel{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;opacity:0;cursor:pointer;border:none;background:transparent;font-size:.7rem} .rot-cal-cell.overridden{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #f59e0b .rot-cal-cell.has-num{background:#ecfeff;border-color:#67e8f9} /* ── VACANCES ── */ .vac-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:8px} .vac-worker{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px} .vac-fill{height:100%;border-radius:3px;background:var(--green-m);transition:width .3s} .vac-months{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:2px} .vac-m{height:16px;border-radius:2px;border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.58rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;transition:all .1s} .vac-m:hover{border-color:var(--green-m)} .vac-m.sel{background:var(--green-m);color:#fff;border-color:var(--green)} /* ── RESUM ANUAL ── */ table.ra{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:.72rem} table.ra th{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;padding:6px 8px;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:600;position:sticky;top:0;text-align:center} table.ra th:first-child{text-align:left} table.ra td{padding:4px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);text-align:center;font-family:var(--mono)} table.ra .ra-pos{color:var(--green)}.ra-neg{color:var(--red)}.ra-zer{color:var(--ink3)} /* ── MODAL ── */ .overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.42);z-index:500;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .2s} .overlay.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:all} .modal{background:var(--white);border-radius:var(--r2);box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.18);width:460px;max-width:calc(100vw - .modal-hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:13px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:700;font-size:.86rem} .modal-body{padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px} .modal-ftr{padding:11px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;gap:7px;justify-content:flex-end} .frow{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px} .frow label{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700} .frow input,.frow select,.frow textarea{border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);padding:0 8px;font-family:var(--font);font-size:.78rem;outline:none;height:30px} .frow textarea{height:auto;padding:6px 8px;resize:vertical} .frow input:focus,.frow select:focus,.frow .dp{position:fixed;right:0;top:46px;bottom:0;width:280px;background:var(--white);border-left:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:-4px 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,.08);z-index:200;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .22s ease} .dp.open{transform:none} .dp-hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:11px 13px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg)} .dp-hdr h3{font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;max-width:200px} .dp-body{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px} .dp-sect{font-size:.62rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink3);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.09em;margin-bottom:2px} .dp-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:.74rem} .dp-row .dl{color:var(--ink3)}.dp-row .dv{font-weight:700;font-family:var(--mono)} .dp-bar{height:5px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:2px} .dp-fill{height:100%;border-radius:3px;transition:width .3s} /* ── CALENDARI CONTRACTE ── */ .cal-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.48);z-index:600;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .2s} .cal-overlay.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:all} .cal-modal{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,.22);width:820px;max-width:calc(100vw - .cal-hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:13px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:#1e3a8a;border-radius:10px 10px 0 0;color:#fff} .cal-hdr-title{font-size:.88rem;font-weight:700} .cal-hdr-sub{font-size:.72rem;opacity:.75;margin-top:2px} .cal-range-info{background:#dbeafe;border-radius:6px;padding:8px 16px;margin:12px 16px .cal-month{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden} .cal-m-hdr{background:#f8fafc;padding:5px 8px;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;text-align:center;border-bottom:1px solid .cal-dh{font-size:.56rem;font-weight:700;color:#94a3b8;text-align:center;padding:3px 1px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)} .cal-dh.we{color:#8b5cf6}
